description: AI Alpha Mapper Discrimination Sprint acceptance Golden Set for A101/A102/A103. This is the current implementation's acceptance fixture, not a permanent frozen contract -- it may be revised as the implementation improves, as long as revisions are not made merely to force a failing test to pass.

cases.claim_text: Hyperscalers raised AI capex for model training.
cases.description: Mandatory case 1: AI investment anchor + training anchor, both with a positive predicate.

cases.claim_text: GPU orders increased.
cases.description: Mandatory case 2: accelerator anchor with an order/change predicate.

cases.claim_text: AI training demand slowed.
cases.description: Mandatory case 18: training anchor with a negative predicate.

cases.claim_text: GPU demand increased.
cases.description: A102 hard-gate explicit reject list: admits A101 via the accelerator anchor, never A102/A103.

cases.claim_text: Cloud providers raised AI capex.
cases.description: Disambiguation rule three (cloud): AI investment anchor admits A101 only; bare 'cloud' has no admission power of its own.

cases.claim_text: AI training demand increased.
cases.description: Disambiguation rule five (AI demand): training-qualified demand admits A101.

cases.claim_text: AI capital spending increased for accelerator purchases.
cases.description: Investment anchor group ('AI capital spending') co-located with a positive predicate.

cases.claim_text: AI training demand declined amid weaker enterprise budgets.
cases.description: Training anchor with a negative predicate; generic 'enterprise budgets' language does not add A102.

cases.claim_text: Enterprise AI agents doubled token generation.
cases.description: Mandatory case 3: AI agent anchor and token generation anchor, both with a positive predicate.

cases.claim_text: Inference workloads in data centers increased.
cases.description: Mandatory case 4 (critical disambiguation): data centers are only the location the workload runs in, not a buildout/demand subject, so A103 must not admit.

cases.claim_text: Cloud inference capacity was reduced.
cases.description: Mandatory case 16: inference capacity anchor with a negative predicate.

cases.claim_text: Inference requests increased.
cases.description: A102 hard-gate explicit accept list.

cases.claim_text: Token generation doubled.
cases.description: A102 hard-gate explicit accept list.

cases.claim_text: AI agent workloads expanded.
cases.description: A102 hard-gate explicit accept list.

cases.claim_text: Production model serving demand slowed.
cases.description: A102 hard-gate explicit accept list, negative predicate.

cases.claim_text: Enterprise AI application usage rose.
cases.description: Qualified 'enterprise AI application' anchor (bare 'enterprise AI' alone would not qualify).

cases.claim_text: Inference demand increased.
cases.description: Disambiguation rule five (AI demand): inference-qualified demand admits A102 only.

cases.claim_text: New data-center campuses increased demand for power and cooling.
cases.description: Mandatory case 5: datacenter-facilities anchor with a positive predicate.

cases.claim_text: Server and networking orders declined.
cases.description: Mandatory case 6: compute-hardware and networking anchors with a negative predicate.

cases.claim_text: Power infrastructure expansion was delayed.
cases.description: Mandatory case 17: power anchor with a negative predicate.

cases.claim_text: Data-center construction increased.
cases.description: A103 hard-gate explicit accept list.

cases.claim_text: Server orders rose.
cases.description: A103 hard-gate explicit accept list.

cases.claim_text: Networking demand weakened.
cases.description: A103 hard-gate explicit accept list, negative predicate.

cases.claim_text: Liquid-cooling capacity increased.
cases.description: A103 hard-gate explicit accept list.

cases.claim_text: AI data-center capex for servers and cooling was cut.
cases.description: A103 hard-gate explicit accept list; 'AI data-center capex' is not the literal 'AI capex' A101 anchor phrase.

cases.claim_text: Data-center construction accelerated.
cases.description: A102 hard-gate explicit reject list sentence; independently verified to admit A103.

cases.claim_text: AI data-center server demand increased.
cases.description: Disambiguation rule five (AI demand): datacenter/server-qualified demand admits A103 only.

cases.claim_text: Cloud providers built new data-center capacity.
cases.description: Disambiguation rule three (cloud): buildout of data-center capacity admits A103.

cases.claim_text: Data-center power and cooling demand increased.
cases.description: Disambiguation rule four (data center): power/cooling demand at a datacenter admits A103.

cases.claim_text: AI training workloads and production inference requests both increased.
cases.description: Mandatory case 13: compound subject sharing one trailing predicate; each Alpha independently passes via its own anchor.

cases.claim_text: AI training demand rose while enterprise inference requests also increased.
cases.description: Two independent facts joined by 'while', each with its own local anchor+predicate.

cases.claim_text: GPU orders increased and inference traffic also surged.
cases.description: Two independent facts joined by 'and', each with its own local anchor+predicate.

cases.claim_text: AI capex funded new servers and cooling capacity.
cases.description: Mandatory case 11: investment anchor and compute-hardware/cooling anchors share one predicate.

cases.claim_text: AI training investment increased, and the company ordered new servers.
cases.description: Two independent facts separated by a comma, each with its own local anchor+predicate.

cases.claim_text: AI capital expenditure rose while networking equipment orders increased.
cases.description: Two independent facts joined by 'while', each with its own local anchor+predicate.

cases.claim_text: Inference traffic increased, requiring deployment of more servers.
cases.description: Mandatory case 12: inference anchor before the comma, compute-hardware anchor with 'deployment' after it.

cases.claim_text: Inference workloads expanded while the company built new data-center capacity.
cases.description: Two independent facts joined by 'while', each with its own local anchor+predicate.

cases.claim_text: Token generation surged, and cooling capacity was expanded to support it.
cases.description: Two independent facts separated by a comma, each with its own local anchor+predicate.

cases.claim_text: AI training and inference workloads increased while cloud providers deployed additional servers and cooling capacity.
cases.description: Mandatory case 14: three independent facts, two sharing a compound-subject predicate and the third joined by 'while'.

cases.claim_text: AI training demand grew, inference requests increased, and the company added new server capacity.
cases.description: Three independent facts separated by commas, each with its own local anchor+predicate.

cases.claim_text: AI demand remains strong.
cases.description: Mandatory case 7: bare 'AI demand' is not a specific anchor for any of the three Alphas.

cases.claim_text: Cloud providers raised capex.
cases.description: Mandatory case 8: bare capex/cloud have no admission power of their own.

cases.claim_text: The company mentioned artificial intelligence in its presentation.
cases.description: Mandatory case 9: bare 'artificial intelligence' mention, no anchor or predicate.

cases.claim_text: Data-center stocks rallied.
cases.description: Mandatory case 10: 'rallied' is a stock-price predicate, not a buildout/demand/order/capacity predicate.

cases.claim_text: Enterprise AI remains a strategic priority.
cases.description: Mandatory case 15: bare 'enterprise AI' (unqualified) is not a valid A102 anchor.

cases.claim_text: The technology sector broadly benefited from investor optimism.
cases.description: No AI-specific anchor of any kind.

cases.claim_text: Semiconductor inventory improved and chip demand recovered.
cases.description: Semiconductor-cycle language (A201 territory) carries no A101/A102/A103 anchor.

cases.claim_text: The company discussed its cloud strategy at the investor conference.
cases.description: Bare 'cloud' mention with no anchor phrase or change predicate.

cases.claim_text: Capex guidance was reaffirmed for the fiscal year.
cases.description: Bare capex, no qualifying AI/inference/infrastructure anchor.

cases.claim_text: The presentation highlighted broad AI industry trends.
cases.description: Generic AI industry commentary with no specific anchor or change predicate.
